extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT payable before grant of probate
extracted.summary: A private client solicitor administering a £341,500 Bath estate, mostly the deceased's home with little cash, enquires about a £39,000 loan to pay inheritance tax before applying for the grant.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about probate funding in connection with this estate. To take this further we would need the names of the executors and confirmation of their instructions, a copy of the will and the draft IHT account, details of the property (address, title number, valuation and any charges), and confirmation of the date by which the IHT payment is required. It would also help to have an outline of the expected administration period and any other estate assets or liabilities. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the matter and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this email constitutes an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
